decision: fixed RecipeStore bundle lookup using #if SWIFT_PACKAGE Bundle.module with Bundle.main fallback
why: Bundle.module is internal to SPM targets and failed under Xcode app project compilation

decision: streamlined AppTab to 3 canonical tabs (recipes, camera, darkroom) with custom rawValue init for backward compatibility
why: eliminates duplicate Camera & Staging row in sidebar and preserves existing stored tab state

decision: unified Camera & Staging top cards horizontally and streamlined dial card sync status
why: reduces vertical footprint by ~190px elevating dial rack into view without scrolling, and removes redundant staged text

decision: enhanced tone radar contrast and adjusted recipe card grid spacing
why: improves legibility of tone curves and prevents title truncation across cards

decision: portable printf and bash shebang in scripts/validate-image-capture-core.sh
why: ensures script runs under bash as well as zsh without failing on print

decision: added 120ms firmware slot-switch delay and dedicated 0xD18D string data handling in ImageCaptureCorePTPClient
why: camera firmware requires 100-150ms after 0xD18C write to update slot buffer and 0xD18D was wrongly coerced to uint32 when short

decision: syncFromCameraPresetData sets recipeName to slotLabel, clears empty slots, and LoadoutCard prioritizes camera name when verified
why: local draft title was masking the camera slot name and empty camera slots retained old drafts

decision: added ICDeviceDelegate removal/close session handlers, PTP disconnect callbacks, and 2s heartbeat in CameraManager
why: unplugging the USB-C cable left CameraManager.status connected because ImageCaptureCore had no delegate wired to CameraManager

decision: redesigned sidebar with Library section (All/Favorites/My Recipes), interactive C1-C7 dial rack with real-time provenance dots and drag-and-drop, ViewThatFits responsive footer, and wired selectedDialSlot state
why: generic orange square buttons were uninformative and did not select slots in Camera view, footer text was clipped in narrow sidebar, and library filtering was disconnected from sidebar
result: xcodebuild succeeded, 52 unit tests passed, snapshots generated without text truncation

decision: removed Bundle.module fallback in FujiRecipesCore RecipeStore initializer
why: FujiRecipesCore target does not declare a resources directive in Package.swift so Swift compiler raises Bundle has no member 'module' error
